subject: Coordinating APAC/US training blocks — FinVault console + API deep-dive
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@finvault.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finvault.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox + API deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to move to a hands-on session for our engineering and platform teams: a combined console walkthrough (30–45m) and an API deep-dive (90m). Our team spans APAC (SG/HK) and the West Coast (PST), so we'd prefer a staggered approach so the API deep-dive hits afternoon for APAC and morning for PST.

Do you have availability the week of June 27? Also: could you share a short agenda and any environment prep/checklist we should run beforehand? We have 6 engineers + 2 product folks who will join — some will dial in late.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform, FinVault
liam@finvault.com
[Attachment: current-infra-overview.pdf (referenced)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@finvault.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox + API deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Liam — great to hear. We can do a staggered session that keeps the console walkthrough toward the earlier block for PST and the API deep-dive shifted so APAC folks get afternoon hours. Proposed plan: 

- Tue, Jun 27 09:30–10:15 PT: Console walkthrough + access runbook (all attendees)
- Tue, Jun 27 11:00–13:00 PT: API deep-dive (recorded) — technical deep-dive with Marcus leading

Alternative (if you want shorter contiguous blocks): Wed, Jun 28 02:00–05:00 PT (this hits late evening APAC).

I've attached a draft agenda and an environment runbook checklist. Could you confirm who will need host-level access vs observer access? Also: do you prefer we split the API deep-dive into two 60m blocks (auth/ingestion, then performance/batching) or keep a single 90–120m session?

Attachments: [FinVault_onboard_agenda.pdf (PDF, 120KB)] [env-runbook.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finvault-onboard-20280627

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@finvault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox + API deep-dive — scheduling

Adding technical context — thanks for lining this up. My preference is to keep a continuous API block so we can demo end-to-end request/response, KV caching behavior, and batching tradeoffs without interruption. Proposed detailed flow for the API block:

1) 10m — Goals & environment state (who has keys, dummy traffic limits)
2) 25m — Auth, routing policies, model variant fallbacks
3) 40m — Live requests: batching, prefix caching, latency profiling (we'll run 3 scenarios)
4) 25m — Q&A + follow-ups (observability hooks / rollouts)

If you'd rather shorter segments for shift coverage, we can split after the live requests section and reconvene for Q&A. I'll prepare a lightweight demo dataset and request generator (will upload to the Drive link).

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@finvault.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox + API deep-dive — scheduling

Thanks Sofia/Marcus — the Tue, Jun 27 plan works for us (Console 09:30 PT; API 11:00–13:00 PT). Priya and I will be hosts on the FinVault side; we'll grant host-level creds to Marcus and Sofia for the console portion. Please go ahead and record the API block (need for internal review).

Two quick asks before the session: 
- Can you add the attendee list (names + emails) to the calendar invite?
- We prefer the single continuous API block — Marcus's flow looks perfect.

We'll run the env-checklist tomorrow morning and ping if anything blocks. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform, FinVault
liam@finvault.com
